title: KV-COBRA: KV Cache Compression via Co-Optimized Bit-Rank Allocation
selection_reason: KV-COBRA co-optimizes rank and bit width per attention head to improve extreme-rate KV compression with no per-token overhead, directly relevant to hierarchical memory and KV-cache compression.
